query:
UPDATE media_files
            SET is_available = TRUE,
                tombstoned_at = NULL,
                tombstone_reason = NULL,
                fingerprint_device_id = $3,
                fingerprint_inode = $4,
                fingerprint_size = $5,
                fingerprint_mtime_ms = $6,
                fingerprint_weak_hash = $7,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE library_id = $1 AND file_path = $2
